sloka: यदि सत् स्यात् सतां मुख्य नासत् स्यात्तव किञ्चन।त्वया यदीदृशं प्राप्तं तस्मात् सन्नोपपद्यते ।। ६.८३.२५ ।।
transliteration: yadi sat syāt satāṁ mukhya nāsat syāttava kiñcana।tvayā yadīdṛśaṁ prāptaṁ tasmāt sannopapadyate ।। 6.83.25 ।।

translations.english: "O foremost among the victorious! To you, who are a jewel no evil should accrue. Since such difficulty has been faced by you, the fact that good actions result in good destiny is not true."
